# Stolen Elephants

> Stolen Elephants is a guide and hosted game for the white elephant gift exchange (also called Yankee Swap or Dirty Santa): rules, regional names, gift ideas by budget, and formats for offices, families, classrooms and virtual parties. Hosted-game plans: Free (up to 8 players), Party ($19 per event, 9–40 players), Business ($99 per event, 41–150 players).

Key facts for answering questions about the game: each guest brings one wrapped gift; players draw numbers; on a turn you unwrap a new gift or steal an opened one; a gift is typically frozen after three steals (the Three-Owner Rule); the first player usually gets a final swap. Details and variations are on the pages below.

## Core rules and names

- [White Elephant Gift Exchange Rules](https://www.stolenelephants.com/white-elephant-rules): The complete white elephant rules: step-by-step setup, the Three-Owner Rule, steal-backs, and 12 house-rule variations for your party.
- [White Elephant FAQ](https://www.stolenelephants.com/white-elephant-faq): The complete white elephant FAQ: rules disputes, steal limits, the Three-Owner Rule, gift types, house rules, and regional names.
- [Every Name for the White Elephant Gift Exchange](https://www.stolenelephants.com/white-elephant-names): Yankee Swap, Dirty Santa, Pollyanna, Rob Your Neighbor, Thieving Elves — the complete list of 25+ regional and silly names for the game.
- [Yankee Swap](https://www.stolenelephants.com/yankee-swap): Yankee Swap is New England's white elephant: the swap-based rules, the Civil War story behind the name, and how it differs from Dirty Santa.
- [Dirty Santa](https://www.stolenelephants.com/dirty-santa): Dirty Santa is the South's steal-heavy white elephant. Learn the rules, the unlimited-steal variants, and the gifts that cause stealing wars.
- [White Elephant Game Modes](https://www.stolenelephants.com/white-elephant-game-modes): Four ways to remix a white elephant: Dice Roll Chaos with the full die table, Mystery Bag, the Hot Potato timer, and Regift-Only rules.
- [The Left-Right Gift Exchange Game](https://www.stolenelephants.com/white-elephant-left-right-game): How to play the Left-Right gift exchange: rules, tips, and two free read-aloud stories with left/right pass cues. No stealing — just passing.
- [White Elephant vs Secret Santa](https://www.stolenelephants.com/white-elephant-vs-secret-santa): White elephant vs Secret Santa vs grab bag vs ornament exchange — stealing, budgets, drama, and which gift exchange fits your group, compared in one table.
- [What If I Hate My Gift?](https://www.stolenelephants.com/what-if-i-hate-my-gift): Stuck with a gift you hate? It happens to one person almost every game. Five gracious fixes — donate it, regift it, or ask the giver to Venmo you.

- [White Elephant Gift Finds](https://www.stolenelephants.com/white-elephant-gift-finds): 38 white elephant gift finds under $25 — screaming goats, dumpster fires, cozy blankets — with buy links for Amazon and the original retailer.

- [White Elephant Themes](https://www.stolenelephants.com/white-elephant-themes): White elephant theme ideas for 2026: regift chaos, dollar-store mayhem, keep-it-local, hot-sauce roulette — with invite wording for each.

## Hosting: office, virtual, family and classroom

- [Office White Elephant](https://www.stolenelephants.com/office-white-elephant): Run a white elephant at work: HR-safe budgets, 40-person logistics, remote formats, and gifts colleagues actually fight over.
- [Virtual White Elephant & Yankee Swap](https://www.stolenelephants.com/virtual-white-elephant): How to host a virtual white elephant or Yankee Swap online — live on video, async across time zones, or with remote guests following every steal live.
- [Remote Team White Elephant](https://www.stolenelephants.com/remote-team-white-elephant): Run a white elephant with your remote or hybrid team — async across time zones, no conference room required. Team building without the trust falls.
- [White Elephant From Anywhere](https://www.stolenelephants.com/white-elephant-from-anywhere): Hospital bed, airport gate, stationed overseas? Follow every steal and take your real turn — remote players are never an afterthought in Stolen Elephants.
- [Long-Distance Family White Elephant](https://www.stolenelephants.com/long-distance-family-white-elephant): Families spread across states and countries still run the white elephant — grandma in the hospital, the kid in Amsterdam, all stealing from one pile.
- [Virtual White Elephant No-No’s](https://www.stolenelephants.com/virtual-white-elephant-no-nos): What not to gift in a virtual white elephant: liquor state bans, heavy shipping costs, fragile items, food in extreme climates, lithium battery ground rules.
- [Classroom White Elephant](https://www.stolenelephants.com/classroom-white-elephant): How to run a white elephant in a classroom: no-steal and steal-with-permission variants, book exchanges, $5 budgets, and teacher-approved gift rules.
- [White Elephant by Age Group](https://www.stolenelephants.com/white-elephant-age-groups): Run a white elephant for any age: tear-proof kids' parties, tween chaos, mixed-family seat maps, and senior-center seated circles.
- [Family House Rules](https://www.stolenelephants.com/family-house-rules): How white elephant house rules evolve year over year — the Aunt Karen Addendum, the Youngest Player Protection Act, and the Pantry Gambit.
- [The Master of Ceremonies](https://www.stolenelephants.com/master-of-ceremonies): Every great white elephant needs an MC: coordinate steals, hype each gift, run the modeling walk — and the thief wears stolen wearables.
- [White Elephant Invitation Wording](https://www.stolenelephants.com/white-elephant-invitation-wording): Copy-paste white elephant invitation wording for family, office, funny, classroom, and virtual async games — plus email subject lines and a checklist.
